profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at January
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Staff IC serving our Borrower Experience pillar. Communications, UX, Voice and Chat AI, working on scale, efficacy, and organizational growth.

positions.title: Staff Engineering Manager, Flatiron Assist
positions.description: Leading a team working on Flatiron Assist, a Clinical Decision Support tool helping doctors navigate cutting edge research and ever-changing guidelines to pick the best treatment regimen for every cancer patient. Our team focuses on the configurability, reliability, and performance of the application; we also own several integrations with third party payers and health care providers.

positions.title: Staff Engineering Manager, Team Compass
positions.description:
Led a software team building a greenfield risk stratification tool to help keep cancer patients out of the ER and to bend the cost of care. Webapp backed by an ML model.

Team Compass builds risk stratification tools to improve the cancer patient experience and bend the cost of care.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer & Tech Lead, Academics Engagement
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: At Flatiron we build software that accelerates cancer care and cancer research. The Academics team builds products and data integrations specifically for our Academic Medical Center partners.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description: As an SRE my main responsibilities included re-engineering high-performance and distributed subsystems to replace their legacy counterparts, developing reliable and actionable alerting/monitoring systems across the infrastructure, managing incident resolution while on-call, and performing root cause analysis on application-visible production issues.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Contributed to the design, implementation, and release of various feature and stability projects, such as additions to the core campaign audience builder and a high-performance re-write of the campaign link rewriting service. Also served on the system-wide on-call rotation, responsible for investigating escalated support tickets, resolving down alerts, and assisting in incident firefighting.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Designed and implemented a standalone prototype  iOS app functioning as a multi-input audio looper. Each input could have a variety of effects applied to it, be sped up/slowed down, etc. The application backend was written in C++.
